<a id="music_song_table"></a>
### [`music_song_table`](../../../../src/music/music_songs.asm#L7) `$E8C0-$E8C7`

*data*

Song table, 8 bytes per song: stream addresses of voice 0, 1, 2 and the instrument table address (the player uses the fixed music_instruments). Song 0 is the title tune.

- **Read by:** [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers)
